title: NFLPA should focus its push for grass on one team at a time, starting with the Seahawks

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFLPA should focus its push for grass on one team at a time, starting with the Seahawks
sources.description: With the World Cup over, it's time to remove the grass and reinstall the artificial surface at the various NFL stadiums that play American football on the fake stuff.
